text:
Sam (Docs): Opening a tiny PR that consolidates the "Provisioning" and "Autoscale Policy" sections into a single flow. Goal: fewer cross-links, clearer ordering for tenant onboarding. Also added an isolation example and a note about SLA wording. PR: github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/834 :memo:

Noah (Eng-Platform): Can you paste the isolation YAML + autoscale snippet here? I'll run the linkchecker and make sure the renames didn't break API refs.

Sam (Docs): Isolation example (Dedicated):
```yaml
isolation_policy:
  tenant_label: org-88
  eviction_tolerance: 0.05
  preemptible: false
  allowed_models: ['rdm-medium-v1', 'rdm-large-v1']
```
Autoscale sample (policy):
```yaml
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 2
  max_replicas: 20
  cpu_target: 0.65
  cool_down: 120s
```
Small SDK snippet (py):
```py
client.dedicated.create_pool(name='acct-88-pool', tenant_label='org-88', min_replicas=2, max_replicas=20)
```

Ivy (Eng-ML): For the isolation example, please spell out that eviction_tolerance is a fraction of soft-preemptions, not hard evictions. Also add a short sentence linking to the SLA table — otherwise customers think eviction_tolerance changes uptime commitments.

Sophie (Product): Wording nit: current draft says "we may fallback to lower tiers". Product prefers: "automatic fallback behavior may occur under sustained capacity pressure; reserved pools with pinned models are excluded." Keeps legal happy.

Sam (Docs): Will replace phrase and add the SLA table pointer. Also I renamed the SDK param in the examples from `tenant_hint` to `tenant_label` — added a one-line migration note under Upgrading SDKs.

Noah (Eng-Platform): Good. I ran linkcheck locally and found a stale anchor in /handbook/dedicated#provisioning-quickstart referencing #isolation (we now use #isolation-policy). I pushed a tiny commit to the branch to update that. Also changed an API sample that used `tenant_hint` in a comment.

ci-bot: linkcheck started for PR #834

Ivy (Eng-ML): Optional ask: include a short example showing how the runtime chooses a fallback model (priority list) so teams can reason about quality regressions. Could be a one-liner under Operational guidance.

Sam (Docs): Good idea. Adding a one-line example: `fallback_priority: ['rdm-medium-v1', 'rdm-small-quant-v1']`. I'll append in a follow-up commit.

Noah (Eng-Platform): CI run looks fine: linkcheck PASS, build PASS, lint warnings: 1 (line length). I fixed the long line in the PR commit.

ci-bot: CI: linkcheck \u2705, build \u2705, lint warnings: 1

Sophie (Product): LGTM from Product after the SLA phrasing change. Can we avoid the phrase "guarantee" anywhere in the new section?

Sam (Docs): Reworded and pushed. Merging once CI finalizes. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
